question: Which 75-77 change makes reward-fixture-v4 end at 23 trips/no game-over instead of 13 trips/game-over 252.95s?
engine: mohammad 8a4b447 (engine identical to f7ce005), Debug TrafficHost, .NET SDK 8.0.427

connection_differences.note: x, y, current connection bits, variant bits; no other difference for the rest of the game

lockstep_current_vs_spawn_attach_removed.buildings: id 5 red house at 10,7 spawned ~74s with driveway direction 2 (down, outside 10,8); id 3 red destination at 10,9 layout 2 with top entrance facing direction 6 (outside 10,8). 10,8 has no road tile.

unrelated_observation: Per-action afterTrips first differ from the fixture at action 66 (t=67: fixture 3, simulator 2) in every variant, including those reproducing 13/252.95 exactly. The reward test checks only final score/terminal, so this is not the drift.
conclusion: Measured: the drift is the rule-77 native common-endpoint join applied at ordinary spawn time, requiring both the spawn attach and the traversable join cell; the dedup edit has no effect. Mohammad confirmed (8a4b447) the 75/77 joins are intended general Original rules, so this is intended ordinary-play behaviour, not an implementation defect. Whether the original game joins this exact house/destination pair is not independently verified.
